item.yharnam_casino.table_help: Place a deck at the dealer’s edge. Players join by placing chips at a seat.
item.yharnam_casino.wheel_help: Right-click to start the power meter. Click again to spin.
item.yharnam_casino.prize_ticket.tooltip: Present this ticket to the casino host to receive your prize
item.yharnam_casino.chip_iou.use: Show this receipt to the cabinet owner in roleplay.
item.yharnam_casino.cabinet_key.tooltip: Right-click to open the cashbox. Sneak-right-click to set wager denominations.
item.yharnam_casino.gm_key.tooltip: Right-click to open any cashbox. Sneak-right-click to set wager denominations. Never assigns ownership.
message.yharnam_casino.denominations_req: Keep at least one denomination enabled.
message.yharnam_casino.vault_denied: You don't have access to this cabinet's safe.
message.yharnam_casino.dismantle_denied: The player who placed this cabinet can dismantle it.
message.yharnam_casino.key_nearby: Right-click your cabinet to link the key and stay near it.
message.yharnam_casino.vault_founder_onl: The player who placed the cabinet manages shared access.
message.yharnam_casino.vault_founder_pro: The player who placed the cabinet already has access.
message.yharnam_casino.vault_access_give: You can now open the safe on %s using a steward’s key.
message.yharnam_casino.vault_access_take: Your access to the safe on %s has been revoked.
message.yharnam_casino.vault_no_profit: This cabinet has no proceeds available.
message.yharnam_casino.gm_key_denied: Only GMs and administrators may use this key.
message.yharnam_casino.gm_key_inventory_: Free an inventory slot before requesting a GM key.
message.yharnam_casino.vault_owed: %s saved items (%s stacks) are waiting. Free some space and use /yharnamcasino claim.
message.yharnam_casino.pool_full: The cash pool has no free slot for that chip.
message.yharnam_casino.pool_full_refunde: The cash pool filled up, so your wager was returned.
message.yharnam_casino.use_chip: Right-click with a chip. See /yharnamcasino rules for the paytable.
message.yharnam_casino.armed: Bet %s. Right-click the lever or use an empty hand.
message.yharnam_casino.occupied: Another player has a bet on this machine.
message.yharnam_casino.win_iou: You won! Paid %s; an IOU was issued for %s.
message.yharnam_casino.push: The pair returns your stake of %s.
message.yharnam_casino.jackpot: Jackpot! Payout %s and a prize ticket.
message.yharnam_casino.jackpot_iou: Jackpot! Paid %s, an IOU was issued for %s, and you received a prize ticket.
message.yharnam_casino.iou_show_owner: Show this receipt to the cabinet owner as part of roleplay.
message.yharnam_casino.owed: Waiting for space: %s in chips and %s tickets. Free a slot and use /yharnamcasino claim.
message.yharnam_casino.rules: A pair of any of the first three symbols pays ×2. Other pairs pay ×1. Triples pay as listed. Three of the first symbol also award a roleplay ticket. The theoretical chip return is 95.31%.
item.yharnam_casino.roulette_help: Five seats and a dealer. Deposit chips at your marker first.
item.yharnam_casino.derby_help: Use the red starter to begin the race.
gacha.open_help: Sealed. Use in the air to open.
gacha.pack_help: Put the prize in your off hand and the empty capsule in your main hand. Sneak-use in the air to seal.
gacha.opened: Capsule opened. The prize is yours!
gacha.denied: Only an owner, co-owner or staff member can service this machine.
gacha.busy: Please wait for the current customer.
gacha.service: Samples: blue %s, purple %s, orange %s, red %s. Cash: %s. Sneak-use key on top to collect samples, below for cash.
gacha.cash_full: Cash drawer is full. Contact the owner.
gacha.paid: Chip accepted. Use the crank to turn. Sneak-use with an empty hand for a refund.
gacha.play_help: Insert one chip in the left slot, then use the crank on the right.
gacha.turning: The capsule is falling into the tray.
gacha.pickup: Use the lower tray to collect your capsule.
gacha.collected: Capsule collected. Use in the air to open.
chess.yharnam_casino.table_help: Use a chess set on the table. Select a piece, then a square. ↻ resets the game, ½ handles draws.
chess.yharnam_casino.need_set: Use a chess set on the table
chess.yharnam_casino.installed: %s sets up the chessboard. White to move
chess.yharnam_casino.illegal: Illegal move. Choose another square or click the piece again
chess.yharnam_casino.resign_draw: Draw. The opponent of the resigning side cannot give mate
chess.yharnam_casino.promote: Promotion: choose one of the four pieces on the near edge
chess.yharnam_casino.claim_move: Choose the intended move for the draw claim
chess.yharnam_casino.offer: %s offers a draw. Another player can press ½ to accept
chess.yharnam_casino.reset: %s starts a new game. White to move
chess.yharnam_casino.draw_too_early: Both sides must make a move before agreeing to a draw
